title: Early Return Reduction of the Kestrel Advantage Balloon Return Fee
content:
**Customer notice — returning before maturity.** A customer who returns the vehicle under a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract before the maturity date has the return fee reduced:

| Vehicle came back | Reduction of the return fee |
|---|---|
| At least 15 calendar days before the maturity date | USD 150.00 |
| At least 1 but fewer than 15 calendar days before the maturity date | USD 75.00 |
| On or after the maturity date | None |

Calendar days from the return date to the maturity date count the maturity date and not the return date.

## Boundary cases (maturity on the 20th of a month)

| Return date | Days before maturity | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| The 5th | 15 | 150.00 |
| The 6th | 14 | 75.00 |
| The 19th | 1 | 75.00 |
| The 20th | 0 | None |
